title: A large product recall can provide a repair route while leaving owner-level safety restoration unmeasured
source_unit: U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission Sauna360 infrared sauna and kit recall
geography: United States; Sauna360 infrared saunas, hybrid infrared saunas, and infrared kits

observations.period: September 17, 2026; CPSC infrared-sauna fire and burn recall

denominator.unit: about recalled U.S. sauna rooms and infrared kits; additional Canadian units are reported separately

hazard.value: Infrared panels could short circuit, overheat, and create fire and burn hazards

incident_signal.unit: reported overheating, melting, charring, or burning reports received by Sauna360; no injuries reported in the notice

remedy_route.value: Consumers were instructed to stop using the products immediately and contact Sauna360 to schedule a free in-home repair by a professional installer
remedy_route.unit: offered recall remedy and safety instruction

owner_recovery.unit: missing owner notice, product possession, appointment, repair completion, downtime, safe use after repair, residual cost, substitution, trust, and continued use or exit

observations.method: Structured extraction from the official CPSC recall notice; recalled units, incident reports, stop-use instruction, and offered repair are kept separate from owner-level notice, completion, and safe restoration.
observations.uncertainty: The unit and incident counts are notice-level aggregates, not unique-owner prevalence or repair denominators. The public notice does not identify which owners were contacted, scheduled, repaired, or safely restored.
observations.subgroup: U.S. owners of the recalled Sauna360 infrared sauna rooms, hybrid rooms, and kits; no owner-level subgroup or comparison is supplied.
observations.counterinterpretation: A free professional repair can reduce risk for an owner who completes it, while other owners may remain exposed because of non-notice, access, scheduling, downtime, or trust barriers.

related_sources.claim: Separate Sauna360 bench recall expansion with a new repair route; retained as adjacent product-safety context rather than merged with the infrared-panel hazard.

boundary: This record establishes a product hazard, incident signal, stop-use instruction, and offered professional repair. It does not estimate owner exposure, notice, repair completion, safe restoration, residual cost, durable trust, switching, or exit.

reproduction_audit.retrieval_hash_scope: The hash covers the official CPSC recall page; owner files, raw complaints, direct identifiers, installer records, and repair-completion records are not retained.
